title: Console scrapbook: triage & follow-ups
content:
2026-03-10 — quick scratchpad (for myself)

Morning summary
- 09:05: first page load reports from EU customers: dashboard tiles blank + JS error in console (stacktrace below).
- 09:12: backend 502 spikes from metrics-proxy (EU-1). Possibly query timeouts against TSDB.
- 09:20: started isolating a reproducible case using staging with an EU token.

Observed errors / snippets
- client console: TypeError: Cannot read property 'columns' of undefined at renderTiles (dashboard.bundle.js:1323)
- proxy logs (metrics-proxy-eu-1): 2026-03-10T09:09:22Z upstream request failed: context deadline exceeded
- grafana panels show NaN for request.latency.p95 for several routes (hosted-api/response-time).

Repro steps I used
1) curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer STAGE-EU-XYZ' https://console-staging.redwood.ai/dashboard/owner/12345 -v (got 502 on first try)
2) Open staging console, switch to EU region, load the default workspace -> watch network tab (tile requests: /api/metrics/series?range=1h&query=...)
3) On staging, run small load against metrics-proxy: for i in {1..30}; do curl -s "http://metrics-proxy:8080/query?m=request.latency.p95" & done - observe 10-20% failures

Immediate hypotheses
- TSDB query latency spike due to heavy cardinality from a new tag (customer:feature_flag) introduced by dedicated customers rollout last week.
- Metrics-proxy has a bug where on timeout it returns a malformed payload which the frontend doesn't guard against -> crash when trying to read .columns.

Temporary mitigations to test
- Config change: increase metrics-proxy read timeout from 2s -> 5s for EU region (small risk: longer tail for user-facing requests).
- Frontend guard: add safe-check before reading columns (quick patch in staging to avoid blanking entire dashboard).
- Backfill: add fallback to cached prefix response for slow queries (console cache hit path).

Notes for PR/bug
- PR idea: metrics-proxy: normalize error response to {"error": true, "message": "timeout"} instead of partial JSON. See GH PR idea: /pull/4567 (WIP).
- Frontend quickfix: if (!payload || !payload.columns) { showTileError(); return; } patch in staging to confirm UX regression minimal.

Who to ping
- @Abe Carter (SRE) — ask about recent TSDB cardinality changes and recent deploys to EU cluster. Slack: #infra-tsdb.
- @Priya Desai (console eng) — will take frontend quickguard.
- Data team: check whether new ingestion pipeline introduced tag customer:feature_flag around 2026-03-03. Ticket: RINF-8472.

Follow-ups (todo list)
- [ ] Roll staging frontend guard -> verify with EU staging token (owner: Priya, ETA: today EOD)
- [ ] Increase metrics-proxy timeout in eu-prod during peak window (owner: Abe, ETA: tomorrow morning)
- [ ] Run cardinality audit query for last 30 days: SELECT count(DISTINCT tag_value) FROM metrics WHERE tag='customer:feature_flag' GROUP BY day (owner: me)
- [ ] If cardinality > threshold, create mitigation plan (quota, downsample) and open customer comms if impact significant.

Notes to self (scratch items)
- Remember to attach the error stacktrace to RINF-8472.
- Keep a short blurb for the daily standup: "Investigating EU dashboard blanks; quickfix rolling to staging; investigating TSDB cardinality."
- If we revert the ingest change, coordinate with onboardings team (who owns the feature_flag rollout?).

Random commands I tried / handy queries
- kubectl logs metrics-proxy-eu-1 -n prod --since=30m | grep "context deadline exceeded" | wc -l
- curl -s "https://tsdb.internal/query?expr=count_unique(tags.customer_feature_flag)&start=1670000000&end=1700000000" | jq '.data'
- SELECT count(1) FROM metric_series WHERE metric_name='request.latency.p95' AND tags @> '{"customer_feature_flag": "true"}' AND timestamp > now() - interval '30 days';

UX notes / tickets to create
- Create console ticket: "safe-guard dashboard render on missing metrics payload" with small repro steps and screenshot. (link to ticket placeholder).
- Create infra ticket: "EU TSDB query timeout spike — investigate cardinality" and reference RINF-8472.

Meeting snippet (09:45 ad-hoc with Abe + Priya)
- Decision: deploy frontend guard to staging now. Increase metrics-proxy timeout in EU for next 24h while we audit cardinality. If timeouts continue, rollback ingestion change.
- Abe will instrument metrics-proxy to emit slow-query traces for queries >1.5s.

Unresolved questions / to investigate
- Which customer onboarding introduced the feature_flag tag? get list from onboarding slack thread (#onboarding).
- Does dedicated capacity routing inject customer tags into metrics? Could be double-counting.

End of scratchpad.

---
Personal meta: keep this doc short; move polished notes to shared_drives/engineering/observability/ after root cause confirmed.
